rv.q: Even for Mischief, this is an ambitious show, with rarely a pause in the action.
This is an evening of daft, uncomplicated fun.
This finely tuned machine of comic timing and theatrical chaos is possibly Mischief’s best work yet, offering audiences exactly what they have come to expect – and love – from this troupe.

cn.t: The Play That Goes Wrong team delivers another hit with this Cold War-set spy caper, earning strong reviews for its clever wordplay, physical comedy, and classic British farce sensibilities.
